title: Grateful Dead Live at Orlando Arena on 1991-04-07
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > dBpoweramp > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of an underrated ’91 show highlighted by a knockout “Rueben & Cherise” performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as clear and well‑mixed, delivering the full impact of a strong 1991 Dead set. Reviewers especially love the “Rueben & Cherise” rendition and note the overall fantastic playing despite mixed feelings about the post‑Brent keyboard lineup. The show feels like an overlooked gem worth revisiting.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review highlights both strong performance and good soundboard quality, leading to a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the recording "great" and notes clarity; no specific issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall praised for fantastic playing; reviewer feels it stands out among post‑Brent shows despite occasional keyboard clutter.

band_member_comments.Keys: Vince's keyboards described as tinny and nasally; Bruce Hornsby praised but noted the mix sometimes felt crowded with too many cooks.
